root_cause.text: Incomplete refactoring in commit 302a1f674c00 failed to add mgmt_pending_free() calls in set_ssp_complete() and set_advertising_complete() after removing mgmt_pending_cmd structures from the pending list, causing memory leaks of the command structures and their associated parameter data.
root_cause.evidence: The patch explicitly shows two missing mgmt_pending_free(cmd) calls being added—one in the error path (after mgmt_cmd_status()) and one in the success path (after hci_update_eir_sync())—in set_ssp_complete(). The commit message confirms that the prior commit 302a1f674c00 replaced mgmt_pending_foreach() calls with individual command handling but "missed adding mgmt_pending_free() calls in both error and success paths," while other completion functions like set_le_complete() were correctly fixed in that same commit. The same omission is also present in set_advertising_complete(), where mgmt_pending_free(cmd) is added after settings_rsp().

The commit message confirms that the prior commit 302a1f674c00 replaced mgmt_pending_foreach() calls with individual command handling but "missed adding mgmt_pending_free() calls in both error and success paths," while other completion functions like set_le_complete() were correctly fixed in that same commit. The same omission is also present in set_advertising_complete(), where mgmt_pending_free(cmd) is added after settings_rsp().

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix memory leak by freeing pending command structure in error path before early return.
intent_record.what: Added a call to `mgmt_pending_free(cmd)` before the early return statement in the error handling path of `set_ssp_complete()` function.
intent_record.how: This change ensures that the pending command structure is properly deallocated when an error occurs and the function returns early. Without this call, the command object would leak memory in the error path, as it would not be freed before returning.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix memory leak by freeing the pending management command structure in set_ssp_complete().
intent_record.what: Added a call to `mgmt_pending_free(cmd)` at the end of the `set_ssp_complete()` function, after the `hci_update_eir_sync(hdev)` call and before the function returns.
intent_record.how: This change ensures that the `cmd` management pending structure is properly freed when the SSP (Secure Simple Pairing) completion handler finishes execution. Without this call, the memory allocated for the pending command would leak, as the function previously returned without deallocating this resource.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix memory leak by freeing pending management command after sending its response in set_advertising_complete.
intent_record.what: Added a call to `mgmt_pending_free(cmd)` after the `settings_rsp(cmd, &match)` call in the `set_advertising_complete` function.
intent_record.how: This change ensures that the `cmd` structure (a pending management command) is properly freed from memory after its response has been sent. Without this call, the command object would leak memory. The function now explicitly deallocates the pending command resource before returning.

This matches the core issue: incomplete refactoring that failed to add mgmt_pending_free() calls after removing structures from the pending list, causing memory leaks.

This group directly addresses the vulnerability root cause by adding mgmt_pending_free() calls in both set_ssp_complete() and set_advertising_complete() functions. These are exactly the two functions identified in the root cause as missing the necessary cleanup calls after removing mgmt_pending_cmd structures from the pending list, which was causing memory leaks.

The root cause indicates that mgmt_pending_free() was not called after removing the command from the pending list in this function, causing a memory leak of the mgmt_pending_cmd structure and its associated parameter data.

In set_ssp_complete(), after calling settings_rsp() to send the response, the pending command structure is not freed. The incomplete refactoring removed the command from the pending list but forgot to add the corresponding mgmt_pending_free() call.

Author: Brian Gix <brian.gix@intel.com>
Date:   Wed Oct 27 16:58:58 2021 -0700

    Bluetooth: hci_sync: Convert MGMT_OP_SSP
    
    mgmt-tester paths:
    Set SSP on - Success 2
    Set Device ID - SSP off and Power on
    
    Signed-off-by: Brian Gix <brian.gix@intel.com>

diff --git a/net/bluetooth/mgmt.c b/net/bluetooth/mgmt.c
index ee144fadcab6..bfa08eb4c2b6 100644
--- a/net/bluetooth/
bic_trace_step.reason: The commit introduces set_ssp_complete() as a callback for hci_cmd_sync_queue() at line 1890-1891. However, examining the function body (lines 1763-1809), the function calls mgmt_pending_foreach() at line 1797 to send responses to pending commands, but it never calls mgmt_pending_free() to free the mgmt_pending_cmd structure passed as 'data' parameter. The old mgmt_ssp_enable_complete() function (removed in this diff) was called differently and didn't have this responsibility, but now that set_ssp_complete() is a sync callback that receives the cmd structure directly, it must free it after processing. The vulnerability root cause explicitly states: 'Incomplete refactoring in commit 302a1f674c00 failed to add mgmt_pending_free() calls in set_ssp_complete()'. This commit (3244845c6307) introduces set_ssp_complete() without the necessary mgmt_pending_free() call, making it a bug-introducing commit.

Bluetooth: Add new mgmt_set_advertising command

This patch adds a new mgmt command for enabling and disabling
LE advert
bic_trace_step.code_snippet:
commit 4375f1037d52602413142e290608d0d84671ad36
Author: Johan Hedberg <johan.hedberg@intel.com>
Date:   Wed Sep 25 13:26:10 2013 +0300

    Bluetooth: Add new mgmt_set_advertising command
    
    This patch adds a new mgmt command for enabling and disabling
    LE advertising. The command depends on the LE setting being enabled
    first and will return a "rejected" response otherwise. The patch also
    adds safeguards so that there will ever only be one set_le or
    set_advertising command p
bic_trace_step.reason: The commit introduces the set_advertising_complete() function (lines 3141-3160) which uses mgmt_pending_foreach() to iterate over pending commands and send responses, but critically DOES NOT call mgmt_pending_free() to free the command structures after processing them. Similarly, the function does not free the command data. This matches the vulnerability root cause: incomplete refactoring that failed to add mgmt_pending_free() calls after removing mgmt_pending_cmd structures from the pending list. The set_advertising_complete() callback processes pending commands via mgmt_pending_foreach() with cmd_status_rsp and settings_rsp handlers, but these handlers do not free the commands - that responsibility should fall to set_advertising_complete() itself, which is missing. This will cause memory leaks of the command structures and their associated parameter data when set_advertising commands complete.
